plan.notes: TRUE catalog program name: 'Computer Science, Bachelor of Science (629P, 629)' - General option, Department of Engineering and Applied Sciences. Transcribed verbatim from the official WKU catalog program page 'Finish in Four Plans' > 'Computer Science, General' term-by-term grid, source_url above. Transcription method: read the official catalog page (2026-2027 Undergraduate Catalog) and transcribed course-by-course; per-term subtotals cross-checked against the grid's printed totals (16+14+15+15+15+15+15+15=120). CATALOG-YEAR HONESTY: 2026-2027 is the current live catalog as of 2026-09-30 (catalog homepage lists '2026-27 Academic Catalogs'; full PDF is '2026-2027 Undergraduate'). Caveats: (1) A second official Finish-in-Four plan exists on the same catalog page for the Systems/Scientific Applications concentration; this file records only the General-option plan. (2) The catalog's Finish-in-Four grid does not list course prerequisites, so every prereq array is left empty - never invented; consult an advisor for sequencing. Admission-grade rule recorded here, not as prereqs: admission to the major requires CS 290 or CS 221 with a grade of 'C' or better, and all CS courses counting toward the major must be completed with a grade of 'C' or better. (3) 'Colonnade - System' as printed in the plan grid is the WKU Colonnade Connections 'Systems' requirement; transcribed as 'Colonnade - Systems'. (4) The General option permits 0-3 hours of 200-level CS coursework to count toward the 12-hour CS elective requirement; at most 1.5 hours of CS 239 and at most 3 hours of CS 239 + CS 245 (for languages not covered by another course) may count toward the major. (5) General option CS electives (12 hrs total): one 200-level, two 300-level, one 400-level - the plan's elective slots are placed exactly as the grid places them. (6) Placement/readiness details (e.g. ENG 100 readiness via CPE College Readiness Indicator/Accuplacer) are placement details, not course prereqs, and are not recorded in prereq lists.
